# 3. Helper functions

```{r CI}
calculate_proportion_ci <- function(n, x, confidence_level = 0.95) {
  # Calculate observed proportion
  p <- x / n
  
  # Calculate z-score for the confidence level
  z <- qnorm((1 + confidence_level) / 2)
  
  # Calculate margin of error
  margin_of_error <- z * sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n)
  
  # Calculate the confidence interval
  lower_bound <- max(0, p - margin_of_error)
  upper_bound <- min(1, p + margin_of_error)
  
  # Return lower and upper bounds
  return(list(lower_bound = lower_bound, upper_bound = upper_bound))
}
```

# 5. Clean, merge, typeset

```{r data_cleanup}
# Append sensor_index to instrument_index
# Only join good sensors (bad_sens = N) and overall roi data
merged_data <- instrument_index %>%
  filter(roi == "overall") %>%
  left_join(sensor_index %>% 
              filter(bad_sens == "N") %>%
              select(file, sensor, deployment_id, treatment, 
                     passage_duration.mm.ss., ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., 
                     nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss.), 
            by = "file") %>%
  # Setup data types
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, 
                      levels = c("treatment_1", "treatment_2", "treatment_3", "treatment_4"),
                      labels = c("Treatment 1", "Treatment 2", "Treatment 3", "Treatment 4")),
    roi = factor(roi,
                 levels = c("overall", "roi1_sens_ingress", "roi2_inflow_passage", 
                           "roi3_prenadir", "roi4_nadir", "roi5_postnadir", 
                           "roi6_outflow_passage", "roi7_sens_outgress"),
                 labels = c("Overall", "ROI 1", "ROI 2", "ROI 3", "ROI 4", 
                           "ROI 5", "ROI 6", "ROI 7")),
    acc_strike = factor(acc_strike,
                       levels = c("N", "Y"),
                       labels = c("No blade strike", "Blade strike")),
    # Convert event columns to integers
    acc_event_95g = as.integer(acc_event_95g),
    acc_event_200g = as.integer(acc_event_200g),
    acc_event_400g = as.integer(acc_event_400g),
    acc_shear = as.integer(acc_shear),
    acc_collision = as.integer(acc_collision)
  )

# Get all ROI data with proper factors
all_roi_data <- instrument_index %>%
  left_join(sensor_index %>% 
              filter(bad_sens == "N") %>%
              select(file, sensor, deployment_id, treatment), 
            by = "file") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, 
                      levels = c("treatment_1", "treatment_2", "treatment_3", "treatment_4"),
                      labels = c("Treatment 1", "Treatment 2", "Treatment 3", "Treatment 4")),
    roi = factor(roi,
                 levels = c("overall", "roi1_sens_ingress", "roi2_inflow_passage", 
                           "roi3_prenadir", "roi4_nadir", "roi5_postnadir", 
                           "roi6_outflow_passage", "roi7_sens_outgress"),
                 labels = c("Overall", "ROI 1", "ROI 2", "ROI 3", "ROI 4", 
                           "ROI 5", "ROI 6", "ROI 7")),
    # Convert event columns to integers
    acc_event_95g = as.integer(acc_event_95g),
    acc_event_200g = as.integer(acc_event_200g),
    acc_event_400g = as.integer(acc_event_400g),
    acc_shear = as.integer(acc_shear),
    acc_collision = as.integer(acc_collision)
  )
```

# 6. Utility rate

```{r data-quality}
utility_rate <- sensor_index %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_sensors = n_distinct(sensor),
    total_files = n(),
    total_good = sum(bad_sens == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_bad = sum(bad_sens == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    utility_rate_pct = round((total_good / total_files) * 100, 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Add overall row
  bind_rows(
    sensor_index %>%
      summarise(
        treatment = "Overall",
        unique_sensors = n_distinct(sensor),
        total_files = n(),
        total_good = sum(bad_sens == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
        total_bad = sum(bad_sens == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
        utility_rate_pct = round((total_good / total_files) * 100, 1)
      )
  )

utility<-kable(utility_rate, 
      col.names = c("Treatment", "Unique Sensors", "Total Files", "Good", "Bad", "Utility Rate (%)"),
      caption = "Sensor Utility Rate by Treatment") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, 
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
save_kable(utility,"utility.html")

```

# 7. Collision and blade strike assessment
```{r collision_sum}
# Create summary statistics table for impact events by ROI
collision_summary <- all_roi_data %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sensors = n(),
    event_95g = sum(acc_event_95g, na.rm = TRUE),
    event_200g = sum(acc_event_200g, na.rm = TRUE),
    event_400g = sum(acc_event_400g, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Collision statistics
    collision_total = sum(acc_collision, na.rm = TRUE),
    collision_sensors = sum(acc_collision >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),  # Count sensors with ≥1 collision
    collision_prob = collision_sensors / n_sensors,            # Calculate probability
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Calculate confidence intervals for each ROI
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    collision_ci = list(calculate_proportion_ci(n_sensors, collision_sensors)),
    collision_prob_ci = paste0("[", round(collision_ci$lower_bound * 100, 1), " - ", 
                              round(collision_ci$upper_bound * 100, 1), "]")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-collision_ci)  # Remove the list column

# Calculate blade strike separately (only for Overall, using total sensors)
total_sensors <- nrow(merged_data)
total_blade_strikes <- sum(merged_data$acc_strike == "Blade strike", na.rm = TRUE)

blade_strike_prob <- total_blade_strikes / total_sensors
blade_strike_ci <- calculate_proportion_ci(total_sensors, total_blade_strikes)
blade_strike_prob_ci <- paste0(round(blade_strike_ci$lower_bound, 3), "-", round(blade_strike_ci$upper_bound, 3))

# Add blade strike info only to Overall row
collision_summary <- collision_summary %>%
  mutate(
    blade_strike_n = ifelse(roi == "Overall", total_blade_strikes, NA),
    blade_strike_prob = ifelse(roi == "Overall", blade_strike_prob, NA),
    blade_strike_prob_ci = ifelse(roi == "Overall", blade_strike_prob_ci, NA)
  )

# Format table with gt
collision_summary_table <- collision_summary %>%
  select(roi, event_95g, event_200g, event_400g, 
         collision_total, collision_sensors, n_sensors,
         collision_prob, collision_prob_ci,
         blade_strike_n, blade_strike_prob, blade_strike_prob_ci) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Impact Event Summary by ROI") %>%
  cols_label(
    roi = "Region Of Interest",
    event_95g = "≥95g",
    event_200g = "≥200g", 
    event_400g = "≥400g",
    collision_total = "Total collisions",
    collision_sensors = "Total ≥1 collision",
    collision_prob = "Probability",
    collision_prob_ci = "95% CI",
    n_sensors = "Total sensors",
    blade_strike_n = "Blade Strike (n)",
    blade_strike_prob = "Blade Strike Prob",
    blade_strike_prob_ci = "Blade Strike 95% CI"
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = c(collision_prob, blade_strike_prob), decimals = 1) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "-")

gtsave(collision_summary_table, "collision_summary_table.html")

collision_summary_with_ci <- collision_summary %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract lower and upper bounds from "[X.X - Y.Y]" format
    ci_lower = as.numeric(str_extract(collision_prob_ci, "(?<=\\[)[0-9.]+")) / 100,
    ci_upper = as.numeric(str_extract(collision_prob_ci, "(?<= - )[0-9.]+(?=\\])")) / 100
  )



cascade_data <- collision_summary %>%
  filter(roi != "Overall") %>%
  select(roi, event_95g, event_200g, event_400g) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("event_"), 
               names_to = "threshold", 
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_g = case_when(
      threshold == "event_95g" ~ 95,
      threshold == "event_200g" ~ 200,
      threshold == "event_400g" ~ 400
    ),
    threshold_label = paste0("≥", threshold_g, "g")
  )

# Cascade plot with connected lines
ggplot(cascade_data, aes(x = threshold_g, y = count, color = roi)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = roi), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(95, 200, 400), 
                labels = c("≥95g", "≥200g", "≥400g")) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Event Count Cascade by Acceleration Threshold",
       subtitle = "Steeper drops indicate more moderate-severity events",
       x = "Acceleration Threshold",
       y = "Event Count (log scale)",
       color = "ROI") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")



river_data <- collision_summary %>%
  filter(roi != "Overall") %>%
  mutate(roi_num = as.numeric(str_extract(roi, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(roi_num, event_95g, event_200g, event_400g) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("event_"), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "count") %>%
  arrange(roi_num)

ggplot(river_data, aes(x = roi_num, y = count, fill = threshold)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Threshold", 
                       labels = c("≥400g (Severe)", "≥200g (Moderate)", "≥95g (All)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, 
                     labels = c("Ingress", "Inflow", "Pre-nadir", "NADIR", 
                               "Post-nadir", "Outflow", "Outgress")) +
  labs(title = "Event Load River: Total Impact Through Pump System",
       subtitle = "Stacked areas show cumulative event counts by severity",
       x = "Sensor Journey Stage", 
       y = "Total Event Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

journey_data <- collision_summary %>%
  filter(roi != "Overall") %>%
  mutate(
    roi_num = as.numeric(str_extract(roi, "\\d+")),
    # Create severity score from raw high-g events
    severity_score = event_400g
  ) %>%
  arrange(roi_num)

# Journey plot with dual y-axes using raw counts
p1 <- ggplot(journey_data, aes(x = roi_num)) +
  # Event frequency as bars (raw counts)
  geom_col(aes(y = event_95g), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.6, width = 0.7) +
  # Severity as connected line (scaled to fit)
  geom_line(aes(y = severity_score / max(severity_score) * max(event_95g)), 
            color = "red", size = 2, group = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = severity_score / max(severity_score) * max(event_95g)), 
             color = "red", size = 4) +
  
  # Highlight the critical nadir zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 3.5, xmax = 4.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "yellow", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = max(journey_data$event_95g) * 0.9, 
           label = "NADIR\n(Critical Zone)", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, 
                     labels = c("Ingress", "Inflow", "Pre-nadir", "NADIR", 
                               "Post-nadir", "Outflow", "Outgress")) +
  labs(title = "Sensor Journey: Total Event Load by ROI",
       subtitle = "Bars = Total events (≥95g) | Red line = Severity score",
       x = "Sensor Journey Stage",
       y = "Total Events (≥95g)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Add secondary y-axis for severity
p1_with_secondary <- p1 + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Total Events (≥95g)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(journey_data$severity_score) / max(journey_data$event_95g), 
                        name = "Severity Score")
  )

journey_simple <- collision_summary %>%
  filter(roi != "Overall") %>%
  mutate(roi_num = as.numeric(str_extract(roi, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(roi_num, event_95g, event_200g, event_400g) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("event_"), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(threshold = factor(threshold, 
                           levels = c("event_400g", "event_200g", "event_95g"),
                           labels = c("≥400g", "≥200g", "≥95g")))

ggplot(journey_simple, aes(x = roi_num, y = count, color = threshold)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # Highlight critical zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 3.5, xmax = 4.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "red", alpha = 0.1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Threshold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, 
                     labels = c("Ingress", "Inflow", "Pre-nadir", "NADIR", 
                               "Post-nadir", "Outflow", "Outgress")) +
  labs(title = "Sensor Journey: Event Counts by Severity",
       subtitle = "Lines show total events encountered at each journey stage",
       x = "Sensor Journey Stage",
       y = "Total Event Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r collision_severity_analysis}
# Compare collision severity between ROI 4 and other ROIs

# Get collision data for all ROIs with acceleration magnitude
collision_severity <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(acc_collision >= 1) %>%  # Only sensors with collisions
  mutate(
    roi_group = ifelse(roi == "ROI 4", "ROI 4 (Nadir)", "Other ROIs"),
    severity_metric = acc_hig_max.g.  # Use HIG max as severity indicator
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(severity_metric)) %>%  # Remove missing values
  select(file, roi, roi_group, severity_metric, acc_collision, acc_event_95g, acc_event_200g, acc_event_400g)

# Calculate summary statistics by ROI group
severity_summary <- collision_severity %>%
  group_by(roi_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sensors = n(),
    median_severity = median(severity_metric, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_severity = max(severity_metric, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_severity = min(severity_metric, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_severity = quantile(severity_metric, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_severity = quantile(severity_metric, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_collisions = mean(acc_collision, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_400g_events = sum(acc_event_400g, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Display summary table
severity_table <- severity_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Collision Severity: ROI 4 vs Other ROIs") %>%
  cols_label(
    roi_group = "Region",
    n_sensors = "Sensors with Collisions",
    median_severity = "Median Peak (g)",
    max_severity = "Maximum Peak (g)", 
    min_severity = "Minimum Peak (g)",
    q75_severity = "75th Percentile (g)",
    q25_severity = "25th Percentile (g)",
    mean_collisions = "Mean Collisions per Sensor",
    total_400g_events = "Total ≥400g Events"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(median_severity, max_severity, min_severity, q75_severity, q25_severity), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = mean_collisions, decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FFE0B2"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = roi_group == "ROI 4 (Nadir)")
  )

print(severity_table)

# Statistical test for difference in severity
wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(
  severity_metric ~ roi_group, 
  data = collision_severity,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

# Detailed breakdown by individual ROI
roi_breakdown <- collision_severity %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sensors = n(),
    median_severity = median(severity_metric, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_severity = max(severity_metric, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_collisions = sum(acc_collision, na.rm = TRUE),
    severe_events_400g = sum(acc_event_400g, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_severity))

roi_breakdown_table <- roi_breakdown %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Collision Severity by Individual ROI") %>%
  cols_label(
    roi = "ROI",
    n_sensors = "Sensors with Collisions",
    median_severity = "Median Peak (g)",
    max_severity = "Maximum Peak (g)",
    total_collisions = "Total Collision Events",
    severe_events_400g = "Events ≥400g"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(median_severity, max_severity), decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FFE0B2"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = roi == "ROI 4")
  )

print(roi_breakdown_table)

# Summary statistics for text
roi4_median <- collision_severity %>% 
  filter(roi_group == "ROI 4 (Nadir)") %>% 
  pull(severity_metric) %>% 
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

other_median <- collision_severity %>% 
  filter(roi_group == "Other ROIs") %>% 
  pull(severity_metric) %>% 
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

severity_ratio <- roi4_median / other_median

cat("\n=== KEY FINDINGS ===\n")
cat(sprintf("ROI 4 median collision severity: %.1f g\n", roi4_median))
cat(sprintf("Other ROIs median collision severity: %.1f g\n", other_median))
cat(sprintf("ROI 4 is %.1fx more severe than other ROIs\n", severity_ratio))
cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon test p-value: %.6f\n", wilcox_test$p.value))

if(wilcox_test$p.value < 0.001) {
  cat("*** HIGHLY SIGNIFICANT difference in collision severity (p < 0.001) ***\n")
} else if(wilcox_test$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("** Significant difference in collision severity (p < 0.05) **\n")
}
```

```{r blade_strike_metric}
# Blade strike comparison table - all metrics from ROI 4
strike_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(strike_status = ifelse(acc_strike == "Blade strike", "Strike", "No Strike")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(strike_status)) %>%
  select(file, strike_status)  # Only keep file and strike status

# Get all metrics from ROI 4
roi4_metrics <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4") %>%
  select(file, 
         max_hig = acc_hig_max.g., 
         max_inacc = acc_inacc_max.ms.,
         nadir_pres = pres_min.kPa., 
         max_rot = rot_max.degs.)

# Join strike status with ROI 4 metrics
comparison_data <- strike_data %>%
  left_join(roi4_metrics, by = "file") %>%
  filter(!is.na(max_hig) | !is.na(max_inacc) | !is.na(nadir_pres) | !is.na(max_rot))

# Calculate sample sizes for each metric
sample_sizes <- comparison_data %>%
  summarise(
    hig_strike_n = sum(!is.na(max_hig) & strike_status == "Strike"),
    hig_no_strike_n = sum(!is.na(max_hig) & strike_status == "No Strike"),
    inacc_strike_n = sum(!is.na(max_inacc) & strike_status == "Strike"),
    inacc_no_strike_n = sum(!is.na(max_inacc) & strike_status == "No Strike"),
    pres_strike_n = sum(!is.na(nadir_pres) & strike_status == "Strike"),
    pres_no_strike_n = sum(!is.na(nadir_pres) & strike_status == "No Strike"),
    rot_strike_n = sum(!is.na(max_rot) & strike_status == "Strike"),
    rot_no_strike_n = sum(!is.na(max_rot) & strike_status == "No Strike")
  )

# Calculate summary statistics for each metric and strike status
strike_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("Max Acceleration (g)", "Max Inertial Acceleration (ms²)", "Pressure Nadir (kPa)", "Max Rotation (°)"),
  strike_n = c(sample_sizes$hig_strike_n, sample_sizes$inacc_strike_n, 
               sample_sizes$pres_strike_n, sample_sizes$rot_strike_n),
  no_strike_n = c(sample_sizes$hig_no_strike_n, sample_sizes$inacc_no_strike_n,
                  sample_sizes$pres_no_strike_n, sample_sizes$rot_no_strike_n),
  strike_median = c(
    median(comparison_data$max_hig[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(comparison_data$max_inacc[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(comparison_data$nadir_pres[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(comparison_data$max_rot[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  strike_iqr = c(
    IQR(comparison_data$max_hig[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR(comparison_data$max_inacc[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR(comparison_data$nadir_pres[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR(comparison_data$max_rot[comparison_data$strike_status == "Strike"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  no_strike_median = c(
    median(comparison_data$max_hig[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(comparison_data$max_inacc[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(comparison_data$nadir_pres[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(comparison_data$max_rot[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  no_strike_iqr = c(
    IQR(comparison_data$max_hig[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR(comparison_data$max_inacc[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR(comparison_data$nadir_pres[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR(comparison_data$max_rot[comparison_data$strike_status == "No Strike"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  w_statistic = c(
    # Wilcoxon W statistic for max acceleration
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(max_hig ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$statistic
    }, error = function(e) NA),
    # Wilcoxon W statistic for max inertial acceleration
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(max_inacc ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$statistic
    }, error = function(e) NA),
    # Wilcoxon W statistic for nadir pressure
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(nadir_pres ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$statistic
    }, error = function(e) NA),
    # Wilcoxon W statistic for max rotation
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(max_rot ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$statistic
    }, error = function(e) NA)
  ),
  p_value = c(
    # Wilcoxon test p-value for max acceleration
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(max_hig ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA),
    # Wilcoxon test p-value for max inertial acceleration
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(max_inacc ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA),
    # Wilcoxon test p-value for nadir pressure
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(nadir_pres ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA),
    # Wilcoxon test p-value for max rotation
    tryCatch({
      wilcox.test(max_rot ~ strike_status, data = comparison_data)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA)
  )
)

# Display the table
strike_table <- strike_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Blade Strike vs No Strike Comparison (ROI 4 Metrics)") %>%
  cols_label(
    metric = "Metric",
    strike_n = "Strike (n)",
    no_strike_n = "No Strike (n)",
    strike_median = "Strike Median",
    strike_iqr = "Strike IQR",
    no_strike_median = "No Strike Median",
    no_strike_iqr = "No Strike IQR",
    w_statistic = "W Statistic",
    p_value = "P-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(strike_median, strike_iqr, no_strike_median, no_strike_iqr), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(w_statistic, p_value), decimals = 4)

gtsave(strike_table, "strike_table.html")
```

```{r}

strike_files <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4", acc_strike == "Y") %>%
  pull(file)


# Create named vector of paths with file identifiers as names
file_identifiers <- basename(delineated_file_list) %>%
  str_remove("_delineated\\.csv$")

# Filter to only paths where the file identifier is in strike_files
strike_delineated_files <- delineated_file_list[file_identifiers %in% strike_files]

get_roi4_strike_data <- function(file_paths) {
  map_dfr(file_paths, function(file_path) {
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      # Extract file identifier from path for the file column
      file_name <- basename(file_path) %>% str_remove("_delineated\\.csv$")
      
      read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        filter(roi == "roi4_nadir") %>%
        select(time_s, higacc_mag_g, pressure_kpa, rot_mag_degs) %>%
        mutate(file = file_name)
    }
  })
}

# Load strike data
strike_data <- get_roi4_strike_data(strike_delineated_files)

write_csv(strike_data, "strike_data.csv")


# Create normalized time variables
strike_data_norm <- strike_data %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(
    # Find key timing points
    roi_start = min(time_s),
    roi_end = max(time_s),
    peak_acc_time = time_s[which.max(higacc_mag_g)],
    nadir_pressure_time = time_s[which.min(pressure_kpa)],
    
    # time_norm_acc: peak acceleration at 0.5
    time_before_peak = peak_acc_time - roi_start,
    time_after_peak = roi_end - peak_acc_time,
    time_norm_acc = ifelse(time_s <= peak_acc_time,
                          (time_s - roi_start) / (2 * time_before_peak),
                          0.5 + (time_s - peak_acc_time) / (2 * time_after_peak)),
    
    # time_norm_nadir: minimum pressure at 0.5  
    time_before_nadir = nadir_pressure_time - roi_start,
    time_after_nadir = roi_end - nadir_pressure_time,
    time_norm_nadir = ifelse(time_s <= nadir_pressure_time,
                            (time_s - roi_start) / (2 * time_before_nadir),
                            0.5 + (time_s - nadir_pressure_time) / (2 * time_after_nadir)),
    
    # Normalize acceleration (0-1 scale)
    acc_norm = higacc_mag_g / max(higacc_mag_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Keep only valid time ranges
  filter(time_norm_acc >= 0 & time_norm_acc <= 1,
         time_norm_nadir >= 0 & time_norm_nadir <= 1)

bin_width <- 0.0025  # ~400 bins over [0, 1], adjust as needed

med_sig <- strike_data_norm %>%
  mutate(time_bin = round(time_norm_acc / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
  group_by(time_bin) %>%
  summarise(med_acc = median(higacc_mag_g, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(time_bin)


med_sig_nadir <- strike_data_norm %>%
  mutate(time_bin = round(time_norm_nadir / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
  group_by(time_bin) %>%
  summarise(med_acc = median(higacc_mag_g, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(time_bin)

# Plot A: Acceleration-aligned (peak at 0.5)
plot_acc_aligned <- ggplot(strike_data_norm, aes(x = time_norm_acc, y = higacc_mag_g)) +
 geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "red", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = med_sig, aes(x = time_bin, y = med_acc), 
            color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,700), breaks=seq(0,700,50))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0,0))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
  labs(x = "Normalized Time (Peak Acceleration = 0.5)",
       y = "Acceleration (g)") +
  theme_JN()

plot_acc_aligned

# Plot B: Nadir-aligned (minimum pressure at 0.5)
plot_nadir_aligned <- ggplot(strike_data_norm, aes(x = time_norm_nadir, y = higacc_mag_g)) +
 geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "red", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = med_sig_nadir, aes(x = time_bin, y = med_acc), 
            color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,700), breaks=seq(0,700,50))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0,0))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
  labs(x = "Normalized Time (Pressure Nadir = 0.5)",
       y = "Acceleration (g)") +
  theme_JN() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())

plot_nadir_aligned

acc_plots <- plot_grid(plot_acc_aligned, plot_nadir_aligned,
                        ncol = 2, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1,0.9))


acc_plots

ggsave(filename = "acc_plots.svg", plot = acc_plots,
       device = "svg", units = "cm", width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r pres_sum}
# Function to read and summarize delineated data
pres_summary <- all_roi_data %>%

    pres_max_max = max(pres_max.kPa., na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Create ROI mapping for delineated files
roi_mapping <- tibble(
  original_roi = c("roi1_sens_ingress", "roi2_inflow_passage", 
                   "roi3_prenadir", "roi4_nadir", "roi5_postnadir", 
                   "roi6_outflow_passage", "roi7_sens_outgress"),
  roi_factor = c("ROI 1", "ROI 2", "ROI 3", "ROI 4", "ROI 5", "ROI 6", "ROI 7")
)

# Get median pressure from delineated files by ROI
if (length(delineated_file_list) > 0) {
  delineated_pres <- map_dfr(roi_mapping$original_roi, function(roi_val) {
    roi_summary <- summarize_delineated_data(delineated_file_list, "pressure_kpa", roi_val)
    
    if (nrow(roi_summary) > 0) {
      roi_summary %>%
        summarise(
          original_roi = roi_val,
          median_from_delineated = median(median_val, na.rm = TRUE),
          iqr_from_delineated = median(iqr_val, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  })
  
  if (!is.null(delineated_pres) && nrow(delineated_pres) > 0) {
    # Map back to factor labels for joining
    delineated_pres <- delineated_pres %>%
      left_join(roi_mapping, by = "original_roi") %>%
      select(roi = roi_factor, median_from_delineated, iqr_from_delineated)
    
    pres_summary <- pres_summary %>%
      left_join(delineated_pres, by = "roi")
  }
}
```

```{r baro_sum}
# Barotrauma summary using overall ROI data and nadir from ROI 4
nadir_data <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4") %>%
  select(file, nadir_pressure = pres_min.kPa.)

baro_data <- merged_data %>%
  left_join(nadir_data, by = "file") %>%
  summarise(
    # Counts
    nadir_baro_count = sum(nadir_baro == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_baro_count = sum(rpc_baro == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_baro_surface_count = sum(lrpc_baro_surface == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_baro_depth_count = sum(lrpc_baro_depth == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for nadir (from ROI 4)
    nadir_min = min(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_max = max(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_med = median(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_iqr = IQR(nadir_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for RPC
    rpc_min = min(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_max = max(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_med = median(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_iqr = IQR(pres_rpc, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for LRPC surface
    lrpc_surface_min = min(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_max = max(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_med = median(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_iqr = IQR(pres_lrpc_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Statistics for LRPC depth
    lrpc_depth_min = min(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_max = max(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_med = median(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_iqr = IQR(pres_lrpc_depth, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Transpose for better display
baro_summary_long <- baro_data %>%
  select(nadir_baro_count, nadir_min, nadir_max, nadir_med, nadir_iqr,
         rpc_baro_count, rpc_min, rpc_max, rpc_med, rpc_iqr,
         lrpc_baro_surface_count, lrpc_surface_min, lrpc_surface_max, lrpc_surface_med, lrpc_surface_iqr,
         lrpc_baro_depth_count, lrpc_depth_min, lrpc_depth_max, lrpc_depth_med, lrpc_depth_iqr) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("indicator", "statistic"), sep = "_(?=count|min|max|med|iqr)") %>%
  mutate(
    indicator = case_when(
      str_detect(indicator, "nadir") ~ "Nadir",
      str_detect(indicator, "^rpc") ~ "RPC", 
      str_detect(indicator, "lrpc.*surface") ~ "LRPC Surface",
      str_detect(indicator, "lrpc.*depth") ~ "LRPC Depth"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = indicator, values_from = value)

baro_table <- baro_summary_long %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Barotrauma Indicators Summary") %>%
  cols_label(
    statistic = "Statistic",
    Nadir = "Nadir",
    RPC = "RPC",
    `LRPC Surface` = "LRPC (Surface)",
    `LRPC Depth` = "LRPC (Depth)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 2)

gtsave(baro_table, "baro_table.html")

```

```{r}
# Prepare nadir data from ROI 4

theme_JN <- function(base_size=10){ 
  theme_grey() %+replace%
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(colour="black"),
      axis.title = element_text(colour="black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour="black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black",fill = NA),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(12, "pt")
    ) 
}


# Nadir plot - single box for all treatments
```

```{r baro_proxim}
# Define thresholds
nadir_threshold <- 50  # kPa
rpc_threshold <- 550   # kPa  
lrpc_threshold <- 0.5

# Get nadir data from ROI 4
nadir_threshold_data <- all_roi_data %>%
  filter(roi == "ROI 4") %>%
  select(file, nadir_pressure = pres_min.kPa.)

# Calculate proximity to thresholds
proximity_analysis <- merged_data %>%
  left_join(nadir_threshold_data, by = "file") %>%
  summarise(
    # Within 10% of nadir threshold (50 kPa)
    nadir_within_10pct = sum(abs(nadir_pressure - nadir_threshold) <= (nadir_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_total = sum(!is.na(nadir_pressure)),
    
    # Within 10% of RPC threshold (550 kPa)
    rpc_within_10pct = sum(abs(pres_rpc - rpc_threshold) <= (rpc_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    rpc_total = sum(!is.na(pres_rpc)),
    
    # Within 10% of LRPC surface threshold (0.5)
    lrpc_surface_within_10pct = sum(abs(pres_lrpc_surface - lrpc_threshold) <= (lrpc_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_surface_total = sum(!is.na(pres_lrpc_surface)),
    
    # Within 10% of LRPC depth threshold (0.5)
    lrpc_depth_within_10pct = sum(abs(pres_lrpc_depth - lrpc_threshold) <= (lrpc_threshold * 0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
    lrpc_depth_total = sum(!is.na(pres_lrpc_depth))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    nadir_pct = round((nadir_within_10pct / nadir_total) * 100, 1),
    rpc_pct = round((rpc_within_10pct / rpc_total) * 100, 1),
    lrpc_surface_pct = round((lrpc_surface_within_10pct / lrpc_surface_total) * 100, 1),
    lrpc_depth_pct = round((lrpc_depth_within_10pct / lrpc_depth_total) * 100, 1)
  )

# Display proximity results
proximity_summary <- tibble(
  Indicator = c("Nadir (50 kPa)", "RPC (550 kPa)", "LRPC Surface (0.5)", "LRPC Depth (0.5)"),
  `Within 10% of Threshold` = c(proximity_analysis$nadir_within_10pct,
                               proximity_analysis$rpc_within_10pct,
                               proximity_analysis$lrpc_surface_within_10pct,
                               proximity_analysis$lrpc_depth_within_10pct),
  `Total Sensors` = c(proximity_analysis$nadir_total,
                     proximity_analysis$rpc_total,
                     proximity_analysis$lrpc_surface_total,
                     proximity_analysis$lrpc_depth_total),
  `Percentage` = c(proximity_analysis$nadir_pct,
                  proximity_analysis$rpc_pct,
                  proximity_analysis$lrpc_surface_pct,
                  proximity_analysis$lrpc_depth_pct)
)

proximity_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Sensors Within 10% of Barotrauma Thresholds") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Percentage, decimals = 1)
```





```{r duration_summary}
# Duration measurements summary
duration_summary <- sensor_index %>%
  filter(bad_sens == "N") %>%
  select(treatment, passage_duration.mm.ss., ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., 
         nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss.) %>%
  # Convert mm:ss format to seconds for calculations
  mutate(
    passage_duration_sec = as.numeric(str_extract(passage_duration.mm.ss., "\\d+")) * 60 + 
                          as.numeric(str_extract(passage_duration.mm.ss., "(?<=:)\\d+")),
    ingress_nadir_sec = as.numeric(str_extract(ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., "\\d+")) * 60 + 
                       as.numeric(str_extract(ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., "(?<=:)\\d+")),
    nadir_outgress_sec = as.numeric(str_extract(nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss., "\\d+")) * 60 + 
                        as.numeric(str_extract(nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss., "(?<=:)\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    # Passage duration
    passage_mean = mean(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    passage_median = median(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    passage_sd = sd(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    passage_min = min(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    passage_max = max(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Ingress to nadir duration
    ingress_nadir_mean = mean(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    ingress_nadir_median = median(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    ingress_nadir_sd = sd(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    ingress_nadir_min = min(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    ingress_nadir_max = max(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Nadir to outgress duration
    nadir_outgress_mean = mean(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_outgress_median = median(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_outgress_sd = sd(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_outgress_min = min(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    nadir_outgress_max = max(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Add overall summary
  bind_rows(
    sensor_index %>%
      filter(bad_sens == "N") %>%
      select(passage_duration.mm.ss., ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., 
             nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss.) %>%
      mutate(
        passage_duration_sec = as.numeric(str_extract(passage_duration.mm.ss., "\\d+")) * 60 + 
                              as.numeric(str_extract(passage_duration.mm.ss., "(?<=:)\\d+")),
        ingress_nadir_sec = as.numeric(str_extract(ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., "\\d+")) * 60 + 
                           as.numeric(str_extract(ingress_nadir_duration.mm.ss., "(?<=:)\\d+")),
        nadir_outgress_sec = as.numeric(str_extract(nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss., "\\d+")) * 60 + 
                            as.numeric(str_extract(nadir_outgress_duration.mm.ss., "(?<=:)\\d+"))
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        treatment = "Overall",
        n = n(),
        passage_mean = mean(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        passage_median = median(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        passage_sd = sd(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        passage_min = min(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        passage_max = max(passage_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        ingress_nadir_mean = mean(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        ingress_nadir_median = median(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        ingress_nadir_sd = sd(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        ingress_nadir_min = min(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        ingress_nadir_max = max(ingress_nadir_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        nadir_outgress_mean = mean(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        nadir_outgress_median = median(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        nadir_outgress_sd = sd(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        nadir_outgress_min = min(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
        nadir_outgress_max = max(nadir_outgress_sec, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  )

# Create formatted table
duration_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Fish Passage Duration Summary Statistics") %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Total Passage Duration (s)",
    columns = c(passage_mean, passage_median, passage_sd, passage_min, passage_max)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Ingress to Nadir Duration (s)",
    columns = c(ingress_nadir_mean, ingress_nadir_median, ingress_nadir_sd, 
                ingress_nadir_min, ingress_nadir_max)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Nadir to Outgress Duration (s)",
    columns = c(nadir_outgress_mean, nadir_outgress_median, nadir_outgress_sd,
                nadir_outgress_min, nadir_outgress_max)
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    treatment = "Treatment",
    n = "n",
    passage_mean = "Mean",
    passage_median = "Median", 
    passage_sd = "SD",
    passage_min = "Min",
    passage_max = "Max",
    ingress_nadir_mean = "Mean",
    ingress_nadir_median = "Median",
    ingress_nadir_sd = "SD", 
    ingress_nadir_min = "Min",
    ingress_nadir_max = "Max",
    nadir_outgress_mean = "Mean",
    nadir_outgress_median = "Median",
    nadir_outgress_sd = "SD",
    nadir_outgress_min = "Min",
    nadir_outgress_max = "Max"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = where(is.numeric) & !n,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "bottom",
      color = "black"
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```
